activity_evidence: The current official site reports more than 10,000 Reachy Mini shipments and offers current Reachy Mini and Microduck products; its store terms were updated September 21, 2026. This establishes current activity rather than a numerical popularity ranking.

products.name: Reachy Mini Wireless
products.purchased_scope: Complete expressive desktop robot DIY kit, including onboard compute and sensors. Not a separately purchasable head or torso.
products.availability: Orderable; official page says lead time up to 90 days.
products.notes: Whole robot has a useful head/body appearance, but do not present its entire purchase as a stand-alone torso. Source mesh licensing and exact hardware revision need review before redistribution.

products.name: Reachy 2
products.purchased_scope: Configurable humanoid mobile manipulation platform with human-scale arms, head, torso and optional mobile base; quote required. Separate arm/torso sale not established.
products.notes: Official product describes 7-DoF human-proportioned arms. Excellent visual body-section reference, but keep classified as a whole robot unless Pollen confirms separate modules for sale.

activity_evidence: Official announcement launched Stretch 4 on May 12, 2026; current purchase page offers it with 2–4 week typical shipping.

products.name: Stretch 4
products.purchased_scope: Complete mobile manipulator with telescoping arm, lift, sensor head and mobile base; includes compliant gripper, battery, power supply and teleoperation controllers.
products.availability: Available by quote; typical shipment 2–4 weeks after payment or purchase order.
products.notes: The arm, mast and head are subsystems of the purchased robot; they are not confirmed as separately sold body sections. Official simulation repository provides models and licensing information.

activity_evidence: Current official product lineup lists Spark, Core, Thor and Bolt; official blog includes June 8, 2026 congressional testimony by its CEO.

products.name: Spark
products.purchased_scope: Complete industrial articulated arm; 7 kg payload and 900 mm reach. Tooling and integration package determined by quote.
products.notes: Suitable as an arm assembly, unlike a bare motor. Public CAD for this exact current product was not found during the timeboxed check.

products.name: Core
products.purchased_scope: Complete industrial articulated arm; 18 kg payload and 1,300 mm reach. End tooling and cell equipment depend on quote.
products.notes: Current site uses Core name at its /ro1 URL. Older RO1 manual references a URDF download, but exact correspondence to current Core hardware has not been verified; do not assume interchangeable model versions.

products.name: Bolt
products.purchased_scope: Configurable bimanual robot with stationary, mobile and vertical-lift configurations; not an independently sold bare torso.
products.notes: Visually relevant upper-body robot, but price, configuration and public model availability are unconfirmed. Keep outside individual torso choices.

activity_evidence: Official 2026 Gen3 datasheet and official ROS 2 repository updates in September 2026 establish current development and commercial activity.

products.name: Gen3 robotic arm
products.purchased_scope: Complete research robotic arm, offered in 6- and 7-DoF variants. Vision and end-effectors are configuration options; quote determines included equipment.
products.notes: Strong full-arm candidate with manufacturer-provided robot descriptions and meshes. Official product page also lists separate CAD downloads for 6- and 7-DoF models; repository verified directly.

products.name: Gen3 lite robotic arm
products.purchased_scope: Complete six-axis compact robotic arm with two-finger gripper; 760 mm reach and 0.5 kg continuous payload. Confirm included power and mounting accessories with seller.
products.availability: Current official product listing; contact sales for quote and lead time.
products.notes: Full articulated arm candidate with official model assets; price was not publicly verified.
